about: Front HI0: findings of the hi lint (src/i18n/lint/, profile hi) that are correct Hindi in one string, each with a reason. Keys are the lint's string ids; `words` are the matched words allowed in that string only, `rules` whole rules, `placeholders` added placeholders.

map:camera.citation.reason: a bibliographic citation (authors, et al., year) kept as published, as French keeps it

map:camera.citationIr.reason: the survey’s published name, Two Micron All Sky Survey, in a citation

map:camera.saveNativeNote.reason: «?» is the replacement character written into a FITS header, quoted as a character, not punctuation

map:tour.steps.help.text.reason: «? कुंजी»: ? is the name of the key to press, not punctuation

original:\" Not Found..reason: VIREO joins a straight opening quote, the search text and this tail (helpNotFoundText, the radio hot list and saved-rows Find); the closing quote must match that untranslated opening quote, as in French

original:(km/sec).reason: a unit symbol with no word to translate: «(km/s)», as every other velocity on screen (French and Spanish write it so too)

original:Comma Delimited Text |*.CSV.reason: the Windows file-type filter separator before the pattern *.CSV, not a danda

original:fragment|Meter Radio Telescope.reason: radioIdCaptionText places VIREO’s telescope diameter where the translation holds {diameter} (Hindi puts the number before «मीटर रेडियो दूरबीन»), as Spanish and French do

original:fragment|You have not recorded.reason: VIREO closes this quote with its untranslated tail ’".’ (PHOTOMETER_RECORD_PIECES.movedTail); the opening quote must match it, as in French

catalog:ph.domainCount.reason: “period” here is the photometer’s integration period (अवधि), not an orbital or pulsation period (आवर्तकाल)

map:radioAntenna.antenna.notice.ra-unsup.reason: |x| are absolute-value bars in a formula, not dandas

map:radioAntenna.antenna.notice.dec-unsu.reason: |x| are absolute-value bars in a formula, not dandas

map:pulsar.pulsar.nativeSave.problem.res.reason: the straight double quote and the vertical bar are among the characters a file name cannot contain, listed literally as in the English (PT6’s and FR6’s reason)

map:objectXMeasure.refInvalid.reason: h m s are the unit symbols of the RA field (hours, minutes, seconds), as its label «कैटलॉग RA (h m s)» shows them

map:webHelp.groups.0.topics.0.blocks.1.reason: the sentence on how numbers are read (decision of 2026-11-19), which the English paragraph does not hold: the en dash of the digit range 0–9 and the examples 1.5 and 24,000 with a decimal point and an English thousands comma

map:webHelp.groups.3.topics.0.blocks.0.0.reason: the English names a stale Tools button; the shell’s button reads «मेनू» (appShell toolsMenu), so the help names it as the screen shows it, as French writes «bouton Menu»

map:webHelp.groups.0.topics.3.blocks.1.r.reason: the site clock panel’s on-screen name «स्थान की घड़ी · स्थिर UT परिदृश्य» holds a middle dot that the English’s short name «Site clock» does not
